2609.13556.title: Domain-Specific Jargon in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis between General-Purpose and Specialist Models
2609.13556.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable proficiency on general-purpose tasks, yet their performance often degrades in highly-specialized technical domains. Moreover, little is known about how parametric knowledge of domain-specific terms is encoded within these models. We address this gap by contributing two novel medical jargon evaluation benchmarks and evaluate a general-purpose Llama-3.1 model against a variant fine-tuned on medical-domain data. Surprisingly, the general-purpose model outperforms the medically fine-tuned model on both tasks. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, we find systematic patterns of miscalibration for the medically fine-tuned model. Instead of reorganizing parametric knowledge, the fine-tuned model places greater emphasis on a small subset of model components associated with jargon-favoring predictions. We find that applying component reweighting strategies against the benchmark tasks successfully suppresses these components and closes the gap with the general-purpose baseline. We also observe that some jargon-sensitive components transfer knowledge to the same tasks involving materials science jargon, suggesting they encode a partially domain-agnostic notion of specialized terminology. Our results provide a case study in which a medically fine-tuned checkpoint does not improve jargon comprehension over its general-purpose counterpart, highlighting that domain adaptation should not be assumed to yield better performance on specialized terminology.
2609.13556.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在通用任務上展現了卓越的能力，但在高度專業的技術領域，其表現往往會下降。<lb/>此外，關於這些模型如何編碼領域特定術語的參數知識，仍知之甚少。<lb/>我們通過貢獻兩個新穎的醫學術語評估基準來填補這一空白，並評估一個通用的 Llama-3.1 模型與一個在醫學領域數據上進行微調的變體。<lb/>令人驚訝的是，通用模型在這兩項任務上均超越了經過醫學微調的模型。<lb/>使用機械解釋工具，我們發現經過醫學微調的模型存在系統性的錯誤校準模式。<lb/>微調模型並沒有重新組織參數知識，而是更強調與偏好術語預測相關的小部分模型組件。<lb/>我們發現，對基準任務應用組件重加權策略成功抑制了這些組件，並縮小了與通用基準之間的差距。<lb/>我們還觀察到，一些對術語敏感的組件將知識轉移到涉及材料科學術語的相同任務，這表明它們編碼了一種部分領域無關的專業術語概念。<lb/>我們的結果提供了一個案例研究，其中經過醫學微調的檢查點在術語理解上並未優於其通用對應物，突顯出領域適應不應被假定能在專業術語上產生更好的表現。
